{{Top|leg}}
The '''Grand Hotel''' was the name of a number of [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]]. It was noted that nearly every [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had a "Grand Hotel" on its surface, regardless of whether it belonged to a larger chain by that name.
